items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: He was with Raleigh and White.

ctx.x: Tulane, with Amos. No, with Demain. Oh, with Lewis. Yeah, with Lewis. Well, that's what I remember.
He was with Raleigh and White.
I can't remember. The Nola band. The Nola band. Who was that? Who was the leader there? Oh, gosh.
